title: Crop and resize page boxes through the page plan and CLI
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-core --lib pages and cargo test -p pdfxi-cli pass; pdfxi pages crop writes /CropBox on a real fixture and pdfxi pages resize writes a new /MediaBox plus a content transform while page text survives; EDIT-006 moves to verified.
notes: Adds PageOperation::SetBoxes and PageOperation::Resize. Resize wraps the original /Contents in two uncompressed streams so compressed source streams are preserved, and validates finite, non-degenerate boxes and positive sizes before rendering.
